name: @red-cup-engineering/uniform-resource-name-equivalence-service
description: Transforms two surface strings into whether they are URN-equivalent per RFC 8141: the NID compared case-insensitively, the NSS compared exactly (with only percent-encoded hex digits normalized to uppercase, never decoded), and the r-component, q-component, and f-component excluded from equivalence entirely because they are not part of the assigned-name. Use when a system must decide two URNs name the same resource without hand-rolling RFC 8141's comparison rule at every call site.
